cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've laid out the buses I missed while you had my keys. Read the times from left to right, please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Waiting time and consequences are separate measures. Three buses here; cold dinner here. Please don't put the receipt on top of the timetable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy you another dinner. Can we clear the table?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's compensation, not an apology. Say you're sorry for keeping the keys and I'll stop the reconstruction. We can use the table for your new dinner.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 chronological reading and A3 distinct measures give professional form to the visible inconvenience, ending in A5 apology requirement.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 elapsed time causes A3 consequence list; B4 meal offer causes A5 distinction between compensation and apology.

relationship.evidence: B2 minimises then B4 offers replacement food, giving A a real concession to redirect.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 table-clearing request to demand remorse while accepting the meal offer.

specificity.evidence: A1 laid out the buses is figurative and A5 your new dinner could muddy who receives the replacement.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 final table-use sentence is more explanation than needed after the condition.
